title: Grandpa's garden
instructions: Sam dedesinin bahçesini anlatıyor. Bahçedeki sebze ve meyvelere dikkat et.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: My grandpa has a big garden behind his house.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: He grows tomatoes, potatoes and carrots.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: There are two apple trees too.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: In summer, I help him in the garden every Saturday.

script.speaker: sam
script.text: I like picking the apples, but I don't like the potatoes. They are very dirty!

script.speaker: sam
script.text: Grandma makes apple cake with the apples.
